\section{Binding scientific requirements}
\label{sec:requirements}

The key words \emph{shall}, \emph{shall not}, \emph{required}, and
\emph{unavailable} are normative.  These requirements define scientific
conformance; they do not assert that any implementation satisfies them.

\newcommand{\JincReq}[2]{%
  \par\medskip\noindent\phantomsection
  \hypertarget{SCI-JINC-REQ-#1}{}%
  \textbf{\texttt{SCI-JINC-REQ-#1}.} #2\par}

\newcommand{\JincDigest}[8]{%
  \texttt{#1\allowbreak#2\allowbreak#3\allowbreak#4\allowbreak%
  #5\allowbreak#6\allowbreak#7\allowbreak#8}}

\JincReq{001}{SCI-JINC shall define a signed spatial-kernel estimator for one
observation and stable array.  It shall consume exact PTC and AST parents
directly, consume no SCI-MAP product, and inherit no ordinary SCI-MAP
normalization, support, exposure, validity, response, covariance, product, or
coaddition rule by analogy.}

\JincReq{002}{Every candidate contribution shall bind one exact occurrence and
the \path{SCI-AST:rtc_output_grid_coordinates@1} continuous coordinate under
\path{SCI-AST_TO_SCI-JINC} \texttt{v0.1/r0.2}, associated with the same
processed sample realization in the exact target JINC WCS.  Row order,
detector order, nearest time, tolerance, shape, cardinality, or numerical
coordinate equality shall not establish that association.}

\JincReq{003}{The transformed signal $z_i$ shall retain its exact PTC quantity,
unit, availability, application generation, retention state, immutable
parents, nonrestored additive reference, removed-component and null-space
state, response/covariance producer facts when present, and producer causes.
SCI-JINC shall spatially transform that quantity without creating calibration,
conditioning, astrometry, empirical noise, or source interpretation.}

\JincReq{004}{Every $\omega_i$ shall come from one exact family/version in the
single PTC-owned positive analysis/gridding coefficient registry.  The family
shall explicitly permit \texttt{SCI-JINC}, and its requested, effective,
observation-resolved, and realized identities, payload, QC, normalization,
support, provenance, covariance meaning, uncertainty, and prohibited meanings
shall remain bound.  The accepted request shall select an explicitly permitted
family, or one exact owner-authorized versioned mode policy shall select it;
no ambient or implementation default is authorized.}

\JincReq{005}{A numerical route shall fail closed when selection by the
accepted request or an exact owner-authorized versioned mode policy is missing,
the family is
unregistered, JINC permission is absent, or the payload/QC/identity is absent,
unavailable, incompatible, duplicate, or ambiguous.  SCI-JINC shall not infer
unity, another family, ordinary MAP permission, \texttt{sens}, loading,
scatter, inverse variance, precision, or significance.}

\JincReq{006}{After the producer-owned coefficient decision, SCI-JINC shall
admit only a finite strictly positive $\omega_i$.  Zero, negative, non-finite,
or unrepresentable upstream coefficient values shall not be deposited and
shall retain the exact profile-defined disposition and cause.}

\JincReq{007}{Every numerical kernel route shall bind one exact scientifically
authorized array-associated parameter-set identity containing finite positive
$s_a$, $a_a$, $b_a$, $c_a$, $(r_{\max})_a$, effective integer
\texttt{subpixel\_n}$\ge1$ with no parity restriction under the
upper-bin phase-lattice rule in
\texttt{SCI-JINC-DEC-PHASE-CENTER-001}, and compatibility with the exact target-WCS
metric.  Base v0.1 requires an affine tangent-plane WCS whose exact pixel
matrix obeys Equation~\eqref{eq:square-wcs-metric}.  A scalar pixel size shall
not represent an anisotropic or skewed geometry.  The exact frame, tangent
projection, reference point, axis order and signs, rotation, handedness,
angular unit, dimensions, and finite nonwrapping topology shall remain bound.
Missing or incompatible
authority shall make the affected route unavailable without fallback.}

\JincReq{008}{The peak-normalized analytic primitive shall be
$\mathcal{J}(x)=2J_1(x)/x$ for $x\ne0$ with the removable limit
$\mathcal{J}(0)=1$, as in Equation~\eqref{eq:peak-jinc}.}

\JincReq{009}{The analytic coefficient shall follow
Equation~\eqref{eq:analytic-kernel}, including its fixed parameter ordering and
$r'_a=r/s_a$.  It shall have peak one, preserve
analytic zeros, and preserve every finite positive and negative lobe of the
complete product.  The second-factor zero shall use the exact root
$j_{1,1}=\min\{x>0:J_1(x)=0\}$ of Equation~\eqref{eq:first-bessel-root}; a
rounded decimal shall not be its normative definition.}

\JincReq{010}{The sample center, half-pixel tie, residual-phase domain,
half-open phase bins, phase-to-cache index, and midpoint representatives shall
be exactly Equations~\eqref{eq:rounded-center}--
\eqref{eq:phase-cache-index}, independently on the two exact WCS axes.
Every positive integer $n_{\mathrm{sub}}$ is permitted.  For even
$n_{\mathrm{sub}}$, exact zero phase shall select the positive representative
$+1/(2n_{\mathrm{sub}})$ under the bound WCS axis orientation.  The selected
nominal central offset shall therefore use
the exact even-lattice center formulas following
Equation~\eqref{eq:discrete-radius}, not the zero-radius limit.  The
positive-axis half-pixel center tie and upper-bin phase convention are the
scientific-owner-approved parts of
\texttt{SCI-JINC-DEC-PHASE-CENTER-001}.  The selected
kernel matrix shall be point evaluated and shall not be replaced by pixel-area
integration.}

\JincReq{011}{Center rounding, tie handling, phase intervals, bin edges,
representatives, phase-to-cache indexing, WCS metric, cache extent, destination
evaluation point, and edge membership are fixed mathematical parts of the
operator and shall not be implementation choices.  Bessel evaluation,
summation algorithm, cache storage, thread order, and parallel reduction may be
engineering choices only when they realize the exact operator and carry the
numerical-adequacy state required by Equations~\eqref{eq:algebraic-support}--
\eqref{eq:numerical-adequacy}.}

\JincReq{012}{$(r_{\max})_a$ shall place the exact first zero of the second
JINC factor and shall fix
$h_a=\lceil s_a(r_{\max})_a/\Delta\rceil$.  The offsets shall be exactly
$\{-h_a,\ldots,h_a\}^2$, and each coefficient shall use the destination
pixel-center and representative-phase radius of
Equation~\eqref{eq:discrete-radius}.  Every resolved square pixel, including a
corner with radius greater than $(r_{\max})_a$, shall be evaluated; no circular
cutoff or radial membership predicate shall be applied.}

\JincReq{013}{Before any footprint evaluation, the exact rounded cache center
of Equation~\eqref{eq:rounded-center} shall lie in
$\mathcal{D}=\{1,\ldots,N_x\}\mathbin{\times}\{1,\ldots,N_y\}$.  An outside center
shall set $I_{ip}=0$ for every pixel, even when its square would overlap the
map; footprint-overlap admission is prohibited.}

\JincReq{014}{For an admitted in-map center, the exact square pixel
$\boldsymbol{p}=\boldsymbol{c}_i+\boldsymbol{d}$ shall be retained if and only
if $\boldsymbol{p}\in\mathcal{D}$ and every other local gate passes; square
pixels outside the finite map shall be absent.  The route shall not wrap,
reflect, complete the footprint,
substitute an interior normalizer, renormalize the edge, or require
JINC-then-crop equivalence.}

\JincReq{015}{Every evaluated $\kappa_{ip}$ shall be finite.  A finite negative
coefficient is normal and shall retain its sign; an analytic zero is a
contract-defined zero contribution distinct from outside support; a non-finite
coefficient shall fail the affected required bundle before deposition rather
than be clipped, skipped, or zero-filled.}

\JincReq{016}{All coupled accumulator terms for one contribution shall use the
same exact occurrence, AST association, sample-admission decision,
rounded-center decision, sample-pixel membership, phase, and $\kappa_{ip}$
identity.}

\JincReq{017}{The required accumulators shall be distinct and shall obey
Equations~\eqref{eq:numerator}--\eqref{eq:quadratic}.  Negative lobes shall keep
their sign in $N_p$ and $C_p$ and enter $Q_p$ quadratically.}

\JincReq{018}{The published signal estimate shall be $m_p=N_p/C_p$ and the
fixed-state normalized operator shall be Equation~\eqref{eq:operator}.  No
$Q_p$ denominator or other local measurement model shall be substituted.}

\JincReq{019}{Algebraic local support shall be exactly
Equation~\eqref{eq:algebraic-support}: finite admitted inputs, finite $N_p$,
$C_p$, and $Q_p$, $Q_p>0$, and $C_p\ne0$.  This state shall remain distinct
from certified finite-precision numerical adequacy.  A rejected pixel shall
carry local invalid support in the \texttt{jinc\_map} role and shall not
receive a finite substitute.}

\JincReq{020}{A finite negative $C_p$ shall be admissible.  Exact $C_p=0$ shall
be locally invalid and unavailable, never interpreted as zero sky, infinity,
or a valid non-finite map value.}

\JincReq{021}{SCI-JINC shall retain the dimensionless conditioning statistic
$\rho_p$ of Equation~\eqref{eq:cancellation-ratio}.  It is an indicator and
shall not itself promote numerical support.  A finite-precision result shall be
numerically supported only when an exact owner-approved
$\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{NA}}$ and matching $\mathcal{E}_p$ satisfy
Equation~\eqref{eq:numerical-adequacy}; otherwise numerical adequacy, including
near-cancellation support, shall be typed unavailable.}

\JincReq{022}{No ambient universal $\rho_p$ cutoff, unit-bearing $C_p$ or $Q_p$
floor, contributor-count/machine-epsilon formula, prescribed summation
algorithm, fixed reduction order, bitwise reproducibility, approximate
fidelity phrase, or implementation default shall be treated as scientific
authority.  A future exact numerical-adequacy profile may define only its
explicitly bounded domain-specific predicate.}

\JincReq{023}{Every claimed numerical-support result shall bind one exact
owner-approved numerical-adequacy profile and matching certificate.  Together
they shall identify the scientific observable; absolute or relative form;
reference magnitude or norm; parameter, source, and pixel domain; numerator
and denominator error treatment; near-zero behavior; simultaneous or
worst-case interpretation; exact pass/fail inequality; uncertainty; lifecycle;
and provenance.  No such profile or certificate is admitted or supplied by
this source packet, so no numerical-support result is presently authorized.
A passing pair shall establish only finite-precision fidelity to the exact
selected discrete SCI-JINC oracle over its declared domain.  It shall not
establish scientific adequacy of the kernel parameters, $n_{\mathrm{sub}}$,
or square truncation; source-response or beam fidelity; photometric or
astrometric performance; optimality; observational validation;
response/covariance fidelity; readiness; or production authority.}

\JincReq{024}{The unit relations in Table~\ref{tab:notation} and the two
allowed $\omega_i$ unit classes shall be preserved.  Common positive scaling of
all $\omega_i$ shall leave $m_p$, $\rho_p$, and $A_{pi}$ invariant; signal-unit
rescaling shall transform the estimator consistently.}

\JincReq{025}{Equations~\eqref{eq:conditional-variance}--
\eqref{eq:general-covariance} may receive a formal statistical interpretation
only when the exact PTC family and covariance assumptions establish it.
Inverse-square units or historical labels alone shall not establish variance,
precision, covariance, or significance.  Any future covariance state shall be
exactly typed as complete numerical, partial, symbolic, summarized,
lineage-resolvable, or unavailable, shall declare omitted terms, and shall
never interpret missing covariance as zero or independence.}

\JincReq{026}{The required coefficient-squared temporal-accounting product
\path{jinc_coefficient_squared_time} shall be exactly
Equation~\eqref{eq:kappa-time}.  It shall square $\kappa_{ip}$, not $\omega_i$
or $w_{ip}$, and shall have unit seconds.}

\JincReq{027}{\texttt{jinc\_coefficient\_squared\_time} shall be described only
as method-specific coefficient-squared temporal accounting.  It shall not be
interpreted as physical acquired exposure, valid-original exposure, complete
temporal support, hits, normalized influence, white-noise-equivalent time,
precision, validity, confidence, or significance.}

\JincReq{028}{Every produced base-v0.1 bundle shall contain exactly five
required numerical map-plane roles: \path{jinc_signal_numerator},
\path{jinc_signed_normalization}, \path{jinc_quadratic_accumulator}, derived
\path{jinc_map} with local support/validity, and
\path{jinc_coefficient_squared_time}.  The compact bundle-level generative
record required by \texttt{SCI-JINC-REQ-044} shall be information state at the
existing plan/bundle provenance granularity and shall not be a sixth product
role.}

\JincReq{029}{Failure to form or publish any required whole-product role shall
suppress the affected bundle atomically.  Pixel-local zero, insufficient,
cancelled, or otherwise invalid support shall remain ordinary bundle content
and shall not suppress an otherwise complete role or create a role-availability
object.}

\JincReq{030}{One observation may produce zero through three independent
bundles, with at most one for each stable array admitted and requested under
the exact JINC realization.  A missing, unavailable, or unrequested array shall
create no placeholder or empty-array product and shall not invalidate another
array's bundle.}

\JincReq{031}{Each bundle shall be independently identified by observation,
stable array, exact JINC plan and realization, target WCS, product role, and
lifecycle generation.  Its compact generative record $G_a$ shall bind those
identities without making a worker, filename, or dense contribution archive
part of scientific identity.  Contributions with different array or
destination identities shall never merge.}

\JincReq{032}{The complete destination identity shall be resolved before
allocation, numerical mutation, output side effects, or parallel execution.
Ambiguous, duplicate, or aliased destination ownership shall fail the affected
bundle without selecting a winner or publishing a partial result.}

\JincReq{033}{Same-observation samples or chunks may accumulate incrementally
only when observation, stable array, JINC plan and realization, target WCS,
admission/parameter/coefficient state, destination, and lifecycle generation
are identical and are replayable from the same $G_a$.  Chunk, worker, process,
container, filename, and vector position shall not create product identity.}

\JincReq{034}{Base v0.1 shall authorize no cross-observation combination.
Any future JINC coadd shall require a separately authorized boundary over
complete observation bundles and shall not infer accumulator addition,
normalized-map combination, or ordinary SCI-MAP coaddition.}

\JincReq{035}{JINC upstream-occurrence admission, whose immutable Registry
identity is \path{SCI-JINC:jinc_map_contribution@1}, shall remain distinct
from PTC signal availability, PTC retention, coefficient availability/QC, AST
coordinate validity and association, finite signal, finite positive
$\omega_i$, parameter availability, rounded-center admission, pixel support,
finite $\kappa_{ip}$, cancellation, numerical adequacy, arithmetic
contribution, and final bundle validity.  The immutable Registry identity
shall not routinely be described as a ``map contribution'' decision; its
canonical human-readable meaning is only that one exact upstream occurrence
may be considered by JINC.}

\JincReq{036}{Only a fact named by an exact restriction shall control JINC
upstream-occurrence admission.  Producer causes and transitive influence shall be preserved, but a
generic flag or cause shall have no universal veto.  Outside support, an
analytic zero, or an outside rounded center shall be ordinary no-contribution;
a finite negative lobe shall not create a cause.  Profile pass shall not imply
rounded-center admission, pixel membership, cancellation support, numerical
contribution, or bundle publication.}

\JincReq{037}{ALIGN/AST, RTC, CAL, PTC, and VAL shall retain the meanings they
own.  SCI-JINC shall own only its admission use, local geometry, point phase,
square support, signed coefficient, normalization, conditioning, fixed
accumulators, local support, grouping, destination, and atomic bundle
publication.  The exact PTC r0.3 and AST r0.2 boundaries, immutable admission
profile, and JINC-specific SCI-VAL successor snapshots shall control
compatibility under the exact-source lock of \texttt{SCI-JINC-REQ-043};
SCI-JINC shall not reconstruct their producer facts.}

\JincReq{038}{Base v0.1 shall publish no response, variance, formal-weight,
covariance, empirical-noise, or significance product.  The conditional
mathematics in Section~\ref{sec:conditional-math} shall remain preserved for a
future concrete scientific use without being promoted to a present role.
Fixed-state JINC response, PTC full-procedure response with JINC fixed, JINC
re-resolved procedure response, and whole-chain response shall remain distinct;
an already realized PTC-grid response shall receive the JINC operator exactly
once and shall use exact signal membership.}

\JincReq{039}{Base v0.1 shall publish no physical-exposure product.  Any
future exposure role shall require separate authority for exact original-
occurrence lineage and semantics and shall not reinterpret
$T_p^{(\kappa^2)}$.}

\JincReq{040}{Base v0.1 shall create no standalone support or availability
role, generic optional or conditionally required role mechanism, detailed operational-cause
archive, diagnostic role, generalized provenance product, or per-pixel or
per-contribution provenance system.  This prohibition shall not remove the
compact bundle-level generative record required by
\texttt{SCI-JINC-REQ-044}.}

\JincReq{041}{No TolTEC numerical parameter realization, recommendation,
optimum, hidden default, or fallback is authorized by v0.1.  In particular, an
inherited 45~m denominator, inherited shape values, or mode-dependent
$r_{\max}$ values shall not be treated as scientific authority.}

\JincReq{042}{A future conformance assessment shall exercise every prediction
in Section~\ref{sec:predictions}, bind any exact owner-approved numerical-
adequacy profile and certificate rather than an approximate acceptance phrase,
and separate algebraic correctness from implementation conformity,
representation/response fidelity, numerical and observational validation,
achieved performance, readiness, and production authorization.  A passing
profile/certificate pair shall be reported only as exact-discrete-oracle
finite-precision fidelity under \texttt{SCI-JINC-REQ-023}.  This frozen
implementation-independent authority establishes none of those later claims.}

\JincReq{043}{Every claimed SCI-JINC contract realization shall bind byte
identically to \path{SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-JINC} \texttt{v0.1/r0.3} (SHA-256
\JincDigest{5769d413}{460e9317}{45e0d401}{ea432b12}{d1077c15}{466247c4}{9caa71b9}{97d4ab1e}),
\path{SCI-AST_TO_SCI-JINC} \texttt{v0.1/r0.2} (SHA-256
\JincDigest{efffa705}{9b59c897}{93fa1d52}{3fb3bb48}{235f1ab5}{5f7d5506}{0af1600c}{bfd470a5}),
the \path{SCI-JINC:jinc_map_contribution@1} profile (SHA-256
\JincDigest{2db95da7}{e5d1b980}{df799939}{07d45ac0}{ababc3aa}{05c189bf}{b62dcf04}{ff2c2e8a}),
and the SCI-VAL binding record (SHA-256
\JincDigest{ee8f20db}{5febdb51}{e39f7157}{449d6c2d}{03a0d170}{58605dd5}{531e9ab5}{ca439e30}).
The bound SCI-VAL source-register successor shall be
\path{SCI-VAL_SOURCE_BINDING_REGISTER} version
\texttt{v0.1/r0.3-map-r0.7.1-}\allowbreak
\texttt{jinc-stage-a-q002-}\allowbreak\texttt{2026-08-28}
with SHA-256
\JincDigest{0e7ca29e}{e2e9cd02}{fb1b76cf}{87cc64fc}{e6164407}{a7801f9b}{9a105ca6}{46317e88},
and the profile-registry successor shall be
\path{SCI-VAL_PROFILE_REGISTRY} version
\texttt{v0.1/r0.3-map-r0.7.1-}\allowbreak
\texttt{jinc-stage-a-q002-}\allowbreak\texttt{2026-08-28}
with SHA-256\linebreak

The SCI-VAL successor identities and hashes shall be process bindings of the
exact source/profile bytes only; they shall create no SCI-JINC scientific
content, PTC coefficient family, TolTEC parameter set, or numerical-adequacy
profile.  Base v0.1 uses an exact-source-lock lifecycle: the complete exact
files named above, including the JINC-stage-A-Q002 source/profile successor

these snapshot bytes.  Any changed bound byte, identity, version,

and requires a versioned SCI-JINC successor before use.}

\JincReq{044}{Every complete bundle shall contain one compact generative record
$G_a$ sufficient to replay its exact input population and immutable PTC/AST
joins; admission evaluation; coefficient family, selection, generation, and
payload identity; parameter-set identity; target WCS and metric; center, phase,
bin, representative, cache, square, and edge rules; cancellation and numerical-
adequacy state; destination identity; requested, effective, resolved, and
realized lifecycle; decision
\texttt{SCI-JINC-DEC-PHASE-CENTER-001}; the exact-source-lock identities; every
required-role state; failure; and completion.  The
record shall use immutable references and bounded plan/bundle information
state, not dense per-contribution provenance or a new product role.}
